sanskrit_verse:
धनं मूलीकृतं दत्त्वा यद् आधिं प्रार्थयेद् ऋणी ।
तदैव तस्य मोक्तव्यस्त्वन्यथा दोषभाग्धनी ॥
transliteration: dhanaṃ mūlīkṛtaṃ dattvā yad ādhiṃ prārthayed ṛṇī / tadaiva tasya moktavyas tv anyathā doṣabhāgdhanī
sph_interpretive_translation: When a debtor, having received principal wealth, thereafter requests interest, that interest must be released immediately; otherwise, it becomes a liability of wrongdoing.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from the completion of foundational transaction
Causation lies in the voluntary acceptance of principal before claiming increment
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by conscious acknowledgment of value received
Restoration logic requires immediate release of ungrounded claims
Consciousness alignment demands transparency in financial obligation
executable_legal_axioms: IF debtor receives principal AND requests additional return THEN release claim immediately ELSE classify as misaligned liability
IF financial agreement lacks explicit consent on increment THEN no enforceable expectation exists
IF claimant has not completed foundational exchange THEN subsequent demand is void
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that interest claims must follow clear prior consent after principal delivery. Absent such clarity, courts must declare the claim invalid and restore balance by nullifying unjust enrichment assertions.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that interest arises only upon valid foundational consent. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential dependence: principal → consent → increment. Proportional responsibility aligns with awareness at time of transaction. The non-punitive reality rule ensures correction without attribution of fault.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion process: verify existence of documented consent post-principal transfer
Responsibility assumption protocol: obligor must demonstrate conscious agreement to incremental terms
Capacity restoration: educate parties on lawful basis of financial expectations
Integrity reintegration: retract ungrounded claims and realign financial records
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: all financial obligations derive from conscious consent, not assumed entitlement. Dharma is restored through clarity and alignment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
